en.text: To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

zhSimplified.text: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 我呼求你，向你至聖所舉手的時候，

en.text: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

zhSimplified.text: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉；

zhTraditional.text: 不要把我和惡人並作孽的一同除掉；

en.text: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

zhSimplified.text: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的，

zhTraditional.text: 他們既然不留心耶和華所行的和他手所做的，

en.text: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌；

en.text: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是他百姓的力量，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是他百姓的力量，

en.text: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

zhSimplified.text: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业，

zhTraditional.text: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業，
